articles.title: 4 in hospital as Toronto police investigate shooting in Bridle Path home
articles.summary: Toronto police say they're investigating a home invasion after three people were shot inside a North York residence early Thursday. They say four people were injured, and two are in life-threatening condition.

articles.title: Man dead after being struck by vehicle in Richmond Hill: York police
articles.summary: A man has died in Richmond Hill after being struck by a vehicle Wednesday night, York police said.

articles.title: Daniel’s Art Supplies, beloved by Toronto artists, closing after 42 years in Chinatown
articles.summary: Daniel Choi, the owner of Daniel's Art Supplies, says the Toronto building he partly leases has been sold and renovations are coming.

articles.title: From spells to tarot: witchcraft stores brew sense of community among young Canadians
articles.summary: A whiff of palo santo incense, cosy lighting and Pinterest-worthy vintage cabinets may have drawn you into this newly opened store in downtown Oakville, Ont.

articles.title: Halton police sergeant charged after chase of stolen Hummer ends in crash: SIU
articles.summary: A Halton police officer has been charged after a stolen Hummer crashed into a tractor-trailer in Mississauga last year following a police chase, according to Ontario's Special Investigations Unit.

articles.title: 1 charge dropped ahead of second Frank Stronach sexual assault trial: lawyer
articles.summary: Frank Stronach's lawyer says one charge of sexual assault against her client in an upcoming Newmarket, Ont., trial has been dropped.

articles.title: Vaughan real estate agent pleads guilty to extortion plot in Project South case
articles.summary: A Vaughan real estate agent pleaded guilty to an extortion charge Wednesday for a plot discovered through wire taps in sweeping police corruption probe Project South.

articles.title: Downtown Oshawa has 2 new progressive councillors. Here’s what they want to change
articles.summary: Downtown Oshawa will be represented by two new progressive faces in municipal politics, who say they’re focused on a housing-forward approach to tackling issues in the city’s core and prioritizing input from residents.

articles.title: Durham police officer charged in child sexual exploitation investigation
articles.summary: A Durham Regional Police officer has been arrested and charged with seven offences related to child sexual abuse and exploitation material, Ontario Provincial Police say.
